concerns.text: Phase 6 (T035-T040) implements 'Simulated Reviewer Concerns' (von Neumann, Turing, etc.) as code artifacts. The spec.md and plan.md explicitly state these are research observations/logic constraints, not functional requirements to be implemented as separate code modules. T035-T040 constitute unapproved scope creep and violate the 'Single Source of Truth' by adding features not defined in FR-001 to FR-012.

T004 requires 'batch size auto-scaling (low-to-moderate range)'. Spec FR-004 mandates a fixed 'batch size 4'. Auto-scaling introduces dynamic behavior not authorized by the spec, risking non-reproducible results and violating the fixed experimental parameters required for the bootstrap statistical comparison (FR-006).

T021 ('Implement exponential backoff...') duplicates T005b ('Implement exponential backoff wrapper...') and FR-011. The spec requires a single source of truth for API retry logic. Implementing this logic twice creates redundancy and potential inconsistency in retry behavior.

T030 places FLOP counting logic in `pipeline/model.py`. The plan.md 'Technical Context' and T017b explicitly assign FLOP counting to `pipeline/trainer.py`. This contradicts the architectural design, breaks separation of concerns, and creates a dependency conflict for T031 which relies on T017b.

T022 implements 'early-stop logic' that terminates the pipeline if degradation ≥5%. Spec Edge Cases and FR-007/FR-009 require the system to run exactly three cycles to detect trajectories and fit decay models. An automatic hard termination in T022 prevents the collection of the 3-cycle trajectory data required by FR-007 and SC-003 unless the task explicitly logs the event and continues the cycle counter without stopping the pipeline.
